verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official MCP server whose tools let AI agents interact with the Stripe API (stripe-issuing-docs-16, stripe-issuing-probe-4), so a user can drive Stripe through natural language via an agent client. However, nothing shows those tools cover Issuing operations such as creating cards, cardholders, or spending controls, and there is no built-in natural-language interface. 'Issuing for agents' is about agents spending with cards, not about users operating the product by natural language, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: evidence that MCP tools cover Issuing-specific actions, a first-party natural-language command interface (e.g. a Dashboard assistant), and hands-on or independent corroboration of natural-language operation.
